title: Runpod SDXL (Text-to-Image · Img2Img · Inpaint)
description: Serverless Stable Diffusion XL via diffusers. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and inpainting across SDXL Base, SDXL Turbo, SDXL Lightning, Juggernaut XL, and Playground V2; optional refiner pass, 8 schedulers, LoRA loading, batch prompts, negative prompts, seed control, and multi-image generation per prompt.

input.name: Default model
input.description: Default HuggingFace model id used when 'model' is not given in the request. One of: stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0, stabilityai/sdxl-turbo, ByteDance/SDXL-Lightning, stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-refiner-1.0, RunDiffusion/Juggernaut-XL-v9, playgroundai/playground-v2-1024px-aesthetic.

input.name: HuggingFace cache directory
input.description: Where downloaded weights are stored on the worker. Point at a persistent volume to avoid re-downloads.

input.name: Allow any HuggingFace model id
input.description: Set to '1' to allow callers to specify any HuggingFace model id (otherwise restricted to the curated list).
